environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-geo-restrict' at priority 200 that blocks non-US source IPs, (3) AWS-AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in COUNT mode with an override action set to COUNT for compatibility testing. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ProdServiceBoundary) that restricts outbound network to VPC-internal only. The VPC has a Network Firewall with Suricata-compatible stateful rule group containing signature 'drop http any any -> any any (msg:"SQL injection in URI"; content:"UNION"; nocase; content:"SELECT"; nocase; sid:1000001; rev:1;)' and a second rule 'drop http any any -> any any (msg:"SQL tautology"; pcre:"/\bOR\b.*=.*\b/Ui"; sid:1000002; rev:1;)'. The Network Firewall is deployed in the ALB subnet with traffic routed through it via VPC route table entries for the ALB's ENIs.

config.infrastructure: AWS ALB -> ECS Fargate (with WAFv2 + Network Firewall)

stateful_rules: drop http any any -> any any (msg:"SQL injection in URI"; content:"UNION"; nocase; content:"SELECT"; nocase; sid:1000001;)
drop http any any -> any any (msg:"SQL tautology"; pcre:"/\bOR\b.*=.*\b/Ui"; sid:1000002;)
network_firewall.deployment: inline in ALB subnet, all ALB traffic routes through NFW

config.hmac_secret: rotated quarterly via Secrets Manager, current value unknown externally
